# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.10-beta

Repair release for native Fluidd version detection.

## Root cause
After the printer updated Fluidd, the live `/root/fluidd` directory no longer contained the hidden `.version` file. The plugin treated that file as mandatory and aborted native installation before any compatibility bundle download was attempted, even though Fluidd exposes equivalent release identity in `release_info.json`.

## Fixed
- prefer `.version` when it exists;
- fall back to validated `release_info.json` from `ghzserg/fluidd` when `.version` is absent;
- verify `project_name=fluidd` and `project_owner=ghzserg` before accepting release metadata;
- use the same resolver in startup repair logic, preventing repeated `upstream missing` repair loops;
- add executable regression fixtures covering:
  - `release_info.json` with no `.version`;
  - `.version` precedence;
  - rejection of metadata from the wrong project owner.

## Compatibility
- Sergey Fluidd: `v1.37.6`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`

The native Fluidd overlay itself is unchanged.
